evidence.ACL: Grade 1 injury of ACL and PCL.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear in medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee with spur formation
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee, more severe at lateral compartment wtih grade 4 injury.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone marrow edema and tiny cyst over lateral femorotibial joint.
evidence.Fracture: Abnormal signal intensity of disltal femoral shaft, most due to post-operative bone marrow change ( removal of internal fixation)
